title: Spider Infestation
description: The miners at Cutter's Claim walked off eight days ago and won't go back down - not for the ore, not for the wage advance the Guild offered to get them moving again. Foreman Alsett says it's spiders thick enough to web a cart axle. The Guild would rather pay a bounty once than keep paying idle wages every week the claim sits empty.

objectives.description: Clear the giant spiders out of Cutter's Claim so the miners will go back down

notes: Threat: Cutter's Claim mine idle for eight days, miners refusing even a wage advance to go back down. Giver motive: Foreman Alsett and the Guild lose more to idle wages than to a bounty. Refusal: the claim stays empty and the idle-wage cost keeps climbing.
